name: moka-harness
description: One person's Claude Code setup, packaged as plugins.

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: Working-style rules for Claude Code, loaded into each session by a SessionStart hook, plus guard hooks that start in dry-run.

plugins.name: core-bundle
plugins.description: The everyday set: working-style rules, guard hooks, session mods, and general-purpose skills. Needs nothing beyond Claude Code, python3, git and jq; a few mods are macOS only.

plugins.name: multi-agent
plugins.description: Tools for running several agents side by side and handing work between them. Needs herdr and tuios installed; Codex and agy are optional; dispatch-router needs a TypeSafe key.

plugins.name: research
plugins.description: Paper search, science, web and video research skills plus a subreddit watcher. Needs a free alphaXiv account for the paper search server, and ffmpeg and yt-dlp for watch.

plugins.name: design
plugins.description: Design and diagram skills and plugins for interfaces, motion, accessibility and technical figures. Needs nothing; design-direction is macOS only.

plugins.name: jev
plugins.description: Mods and skills built on the TypeSafe (Jev) models. Needs a TypeSafe API key, paid per call.

plugins.name: writing
plugins.description: Skills for writing and editing prose that reads like a person wrote it. Needs nothing.

plugins.name: media
plugins.description: Skills for video and image generation. Some need a paid image or video key.

plugins.name: clawd-spinner
plugins.description: Animated spinner for the Claude Code terminal. Needs nothing extra.

plugins.name: fork-cleanup
plugins.description: Off by default. Deletes stale forks from your own GitHub account; dry-run until switched on.

plugins.name: prompt-enhancer
plugins.description: Rewrite a rough prompt in place using project rules and Jev-ranked skills. Needs a TypeSafe API key; calls are paid.

plugins.name: run-ledger
plugins.description: Estimated API cost per run, model and plugin, subagent status, and optional Jev model advice. Jev advice needs a TypeSafe API key; calls are paid.

plugins.name: assumption-log
plugins.description: Claude logs each guess it makes about what you want into a side panel. Needs Claude Code 2.1.287 or newer; tested on macOS.

plugins.name: collision-guard
plugins.description: Asks before Claude edits a file that something else changed in the last 30 minutes. Needs nothing; reads the unattended plugin's state if present.

plugins.name: context-guard
plugins.description: Warns when the conversation context gets large; opt-in auto-compact of idle sessions. Needs nothing.

plugins.name: cache-clock
plugins.description: Countdown above the prompt for the prompt cache, with a compact button. Needs the unattended and layman plugins (installed as dependencies).

plugins.name: image-shrinker
plugins.description: Shrinks big images before Claude reads them. macOS only: needs sips.

plugins.name: input-router
plugins.description: Hands large file reads and connector results to a small model first. Off by default; sends the text to a model through your own account.

plugins.name: read-fence
plugins.description: Stops Claude from opening your skill, rule and plugin folders file by file while switched on. Off by default; macOS and Linux.

plugins.name: skills-az
plugins.description: Lists your slash commands and skills A to Z when you type /. Needs Claude Code 2.1.287 or newer; tested on macOS.

plugins.name: next-steps-autopilot
plugins.description: A What next? button above the prompt box asks for suggested next prompts only when pressed. Type /auto to have suggestion 1 sent after a countdown you set; off by default. Needs Claude Code 2.1.287 or newer. Built on Thariq Shihipar's next-steps (MIT).

plugins.name: unattended
plugins.description: Stops a Claude Code session from asking you questions when nobody is at the keyboard. Type /unattended, or launch with CLAUDE_UNATTENDED=1. Needs Claude Code 2.1.287 or newer.

plugins.name: park
plugins.description: Save this Claude Code session and write a note for the next one. If you use herdr, /park also asks your other agent tabs to save, and can close them. /unpark picks the note up. Needs Claude Code 2.1.287 or newer. herdr optional: with it, /park also saves and /park close closes other agent tabs.

plugins.name: agent-board
plugins.description: Keeps an eye on your other herdr agent tabs: shows their state and context size, pops a message when one finishes or gets stuck, and adds /tabs. Needs herdr and Claude Code 2.1.287 or newer; does nothing outside herdr.

plugins.name: tab-namer
plugins.description: Names your herdr tab and its workspace (a space in the Herdr desktop app) after the task you give Claude, from your first prompt. Can also rename it as the work changes, if you turn that on. Needs herdr and Claude Code 2.1.287 or newer; sends your first prompt to Haiku only if relabelling is on.

plugins.name: disk-sweep
plugins.description: macOS only. Warns when your Mac is low on disk space and, with /disk, lists old Claude Code leftovers you can tick and delete. Starts in dry-run mode: it deletes nothing until you turn dryRun off and list a folder in deleteRoots.

plugins.name: reddit-watch
plugins.description: Watches subreddits you choose, has Claude's small model (Haiku) pick out posts that could improve your Claude Code use, and lists them with links in a side pane. Off until you turn it on. Contacts reddit.com and sends post text to Haiku once you run /reddit on; off until then.

plugins.name: clean-view
plugins.description: Hides tool calls, diffs and command output and shows a plain checklist above the prompt. Needs nothing else; sends a short text to Haiku to name the checklist.

plugins.name: idea-shelf
plugins.description: Park ideas with /idea and send them to Claude later. Needs nothing else.

plugins.name: noticeboard
plugins.description: A /board side pane that explains the question at the end of a reply with explorable options. Needs the claude command; herdr is optional.

plugins.name: design-direction
plugins.description: Shows design-direction options as rendered mockups in the browser. macOS only (uses open).

plugins.name: band-frame
plugins.description: A top rule and tinted background around the band above the prompt. Needs nothing else.

plugins.name: session-peers
plugins.description: Records each Claude session in a folder for a pane such as terminal-desk, and warns when two edit the same file. Useful with terminal-desk.

plugins.name: strict-guard
plugins.description: Allows harmless destructive shell commands and refuses the rest by fixed rules, without asking. Needs git and bash. Apache-2.0.

plugins.name: terminal-desk
plugins.description: Stats bar above the prompt and a /desk pane. Needs Claude Code 2.1.287 or later; herdr optional. Optional second-model check sends your request and Claude's final report to Haiku.

plugins.name: side-chat
plugins.description: A side pane for follow-up questions (/btw). macOS only. Sends your question and the main conversation to a model fork; falls back to Haiku. Its Fork button starts a full-tools agent in the same folder.

plugins.name: layman
plugins.description: Plain-language replies on request. No dependencies; makes no model or network calls.

plugins.name: big-read-guard
plugins.description: Refuses whole-file Reads of text files over 50 KB. Needs awk.

plugins.name: repo-health
plugins.description: Read-only health check of a git repo and its GitHub remote: PRs, merged and stale branches, worktrees, stashes. Deletes nothing.

plugins.name: web-access
plugins.description: Picks the right tool for live web needs, starting with free search and fetch. Needs the treg entry and a treg account.

plugins.name: statusline
plugins.description: Coloured status line (model, folder, branch, time) built on claude-hud. You add one statusLine line to settings.json yourself.

plugins.name: dispatch-router
plugins.description: Asks a TypeSafe model which CLI and model should take each agent task and refuses unrouted launches. Needs a TypeSafe API key; without one it does nothing. Sends task text to api.typesafe.ai.

plugins.name: merge-gate
plugins.description: Refuses a merge Claude runs when the branch touches files outside its declared scope, carries a secret, or fails its tests; stops after three failed rounds. Needs gitleaks.

plugins.name: multi-agent-kit
plugins.description: A skill on splitting work between agents, plus hooks for tuios users (window list, window reaper that starts in dry-run). Each hook does nothing when its tool is missing.

plugins.name: superpowers
plugins.description: Skills for test-driven development, debugging and planning work in steps. Needs nothing.

plugins.name: ponytail
plugins.description: Pushes Claude toward the shortest solution that works, with review and audit commands. Needs nothing.

plugins.name: scope-guard
plugins.description: Counts the files a turn edits and stops at a threshold so you restate the goal. Needs Claude Code 2.1.287 or newer.

plugins.name: smart-compact
plugins.description: Compacts at a good moment: after a commit or green tests, or just before the prompt cache expires. Needs Claude Code 2.1.295 or newer.

plugins.name: micro-compaction
plugins.description: Adds /compact micro, which drops old file reads and thinking from the transcript without a model summary. Needs Claude Code 2.1.287 or newer.

plugins.name: cache-tax
plugins.description: Keeps the one-hour prompt cache warm during breaks and warns once before a cold send. Warming sends model requests that cost tokens. Needs Claude Code 2.1.287 or newer.

plugins.name: secret-box
plugins.description: Lets Claude use a secret without seeing it: you paste the key in a masked box and Claude gets a placeholder. Needs Claude Code 2.1.287 or newer.

plugins.name: modwall
plugins.description: Shows what each mod can reach as it loads and holds or refuses it by your policy. Needs Claude Code 2.1.287 or newer.

plugins.name: claude-code-setup
plugins.description: Reads a codebase and recommends hooks, skills, MCP servers and subagents for it. Needs nothing.

plugins.name: mod-scout
plugins.description: Ranks the mods you would use most from your recent sessions, with a skill that designs them. Needs Claude Code 2.1.287 or newer and Node 18 or newer.

plugins.name: codex
plugins.description: Use OpenAI Codex from Claude Code to review code or hand off tasks. Needs Node 18.18 or newer, the Codex CLI and a ChatGPT account or OpenAI API key.

plugins.name: session-board
plugins.description: A floating board of running Claude Code sessions, with a jump to the tmux window of the one you pick. Needs tmux.

plugins.name: diagram-design
plugins.description: Draws diagrams (architecture, flowcharts, sequence, ER and more) as self-contained HTML and SVG. Needs nothing.

plugins.name: diagram-pane
plugins.description: A side pane that pins every diagram Claude draws and keeps a live map of the work. Needs Claude Code 2.1.287 or newer.

plugins.name: impeccable
plugins.description: Design commands for frontend work: critique, audit, polish and anti-pattern checks. Needs nothing.

plugins.name: modern-web-guidance
plugins.description: Keeps Claude current on modern web best practices, including a Chrome extensions skill. Needs nothing.

plugins.name: watch
plugins.description: Lets Claude watch a video from a link or file: frames, captions or Whisper transcript. Needs ffmpeg and yt-dlp.

plugins.name: typesafe
plugins.description: Skills for designing workflows with the TypeSafe System One API and finding its current docs. Needs nothing to install.

plugins.name: hud
plugins.description: Status line showing context use, tools, agents and git state. The statusline entry redraws its output.

plugins.name: terminal-browser
plugins.description: A real browser inside your terminal that Claude can open and drive. Experimental. Needs the terminal-browser app (brew install terminal-browser).

plugins.name: autoharness
plugins.description: Learns skills from your sessions: after about 50 tool calls a background Claude run proposes new or edited skills, a script checks them before writing, and skills nobody loads are archived. Needs python3 3.11 or newer.

plugins.name: human-in-the-loop
plugins.description: Claude assigns you the tasks only you can do (a key in .env, an approval, a decision). They wait in a My tasks pane, counted under the prompt, until you do, answer or reject them, and your answer goes back to Claude. Needs Claude Code 2.1.301 or newer.

plugins.name: humanizer
plugins.description: Rewrites AI-sounding text so it reads like the writer without changing what it says.

plugins.name: anti-slop
plugins.description: Rules that keep generated UI, copy and code from looking like generic AI output. Six skills, text only.

plugins.name: sepia
plugins.description: Writing skills for removing AI tells: write, review, refactor, recreate and a Hemingway pass.

plugins.name: unslop
plugins.description: Turns an AI-looking interface into a designed one: spacing, colour, icons, copy and type.

plugins.name: no-ai-slop
plugins.description: Edits drafts into sharper, more human writing in the writer's own voice, or flags AI-writing patterns without rewriting.

plugins.name: caveman
plugins.description: Compressed reply mode that cuts prose and keeps code and exact errors. The skill only; the author's hooks are not loaded.

plugins.name: unlazy
plugins.description: Completion discipline for long tasks: write the checks first, then verify before reporting.

plugins.name: pocock-skills
plugins.description: Matt Pocock's engineering skills: grilling, domain modelling, bug diagnosis, writing for agents. The plugin loads the author's whole set.

plugins.name: debug-agent
plugins.description: Debugging from runtime evidence: adds logging, guides reproduction and cites log lines to prove the root cause.

plugins.name: health
plugins.description: Audits a Claude Code setup: instruction drift, hooks, MCP servers and config layers.

plugins.name: tare
plugins.description: Finds where Claude Code usage went, from the session logs already on disk.

plugins.name: gstack
plugins.description: Garry Tan's skill set: browse, QA, review, ship, retro and more. Needs the author's own binary for the browser skills.

plugins.name: diagram-skills
plugins.description: Diagram skills: ArchiMate, BPMN, UML, architecture, network, cloud, Graphviz, Vega and others.

plugins.name: fireworks-tech-graph
plugins.description: Draws technical diagrams from a description and exports SVG and PNG.

plugins.name: anatomy
plugins.description: Builds detailed interactive isometric SVG figures that explain a technical idea as a physical object.

plugins.name: awwwards
plugins.description: Builds award-level websites from a one-line prompt: concept, type, motion, checks.

plugins.name: frontend-design
plugins.description: Anthropic's frontend design skill.

plugins.name: accessibility
plugins.description: Web accessibility checks against WCAG 2.2. The plugin loads the author's other web-quality skills too.

plugins.name: reanimate
plugins.description: Clones a section, widget or animation from a reference site or recording into your own code, frame by frame, then checks it.

plugins.name: blank-page
plugins.description: Turns a one-line motion or design brief into a full prompt with references, beats and attached assets.

plugins.name: infographics
plugins.description: Creates infographics with image-generation models and iterative review. Needs the author's API keys.

plugins.name: hyperframes
plugins.description: HeyGen's HyperFrames: write HTML, render video. The plugin loads the author's whole skill set.

plugins.name: gpt-image-2
plugins.description: Image generation and editing skill for GPT Image 2, with prompt templates. Text is mostly in Chinese.

plugins.name: make-ugc
plugins.description: treg's make-ugc workflow: short user-style videos. Needs a treg account.

plugins.name: k-dense-science
plugins.description: K-Dense scientific skills: literature review, scientific writing, data access, plotting and peer review.

plugins.name: orchestra-research
plugins.description: Orchestra Research's autoresearch skill: runs autonomous research projects as an inner experiment loop and an outer steering loop.

plugins.name: book-to-skill
plugins.description: Converts a book or document into a structured agent skill.

plugins.name: anysearch
plugins.description: Specialist search for finance, legal, code, security, academic and other domain queries, for when native web search is not enough.

plugins.name: agent-reach
plugins.description: Lets an agent search or read the web, Twitter/X, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub and more.

plugins.name: graphify
plugins.description: Turns code, documents, papers and images into a knowledge graph with an HTML report.

plugins.name: big-arrow
plugins.description: Points at a spot on the user's macOS screen with the bigarrow command-line tool.

plugins.name: supabase-skills
plugins.description: Supabase's skills for Supabase and Postgres best practice.

plugins.name: treg
plugins.description: treg: external and live data and generative models behind one tool catalogue. Needs a treg account.

plugins.name: leanrea
plugins.description: Reverse engineering with plain local command-line tools: which command to use for each kind of file, and the traps.
